title: SEZ cell-type activation to MN9 with optogenetic rostrum-extension validation

supplementary_workbook.sheet: Sup Table 3 Predicted MN9 vs. o

reference_rule.predicted_positive: both bilateral MN9 rates are greater than zero
reference_rule.observed_positive: supplementary-table optogenetic rostrum-extension fraction is greater than zero

transfer_protocol.circuit_selection: induced subgraph over the union of every mapped source body's shortest directed paths to either MaleCNS MN9 readout
transfer_protocol.prediction_rule: positive only when both bilateral MN9 mean rates across preregistered trials are greater than zero
transfer_protocol.ranking_score: minimum of the two bilateral MN9 mean rates
transfer_protocol.claim_boundary: Frozen label-blind MaleCNS transfer; thresholds are engineering acceptance criteria and are not fitted to the optogenetic outcomes.

transfer_policy: Transfer source FlyWire identities through the paper-author crosswalk labels, then resolve every label against traced MaleCNS type or flywireType annotations; retain partial and missing mappings explicitly.
claim_boundary: Preparation and crosswalk coverage for an independent behavioral screen. No MaleCNS circuit prediction, V1, V2, or V3 evidence is awarded until the preregistered transfer runs and controls pass.
